# DFG alone vs the Part 5 networks: order per target (generated by order_report.py)

tau = Kendall tau-b over the target's characters ('never' tied last; 'all tied' = one order has a single rank). Positive = same order.  Axes: network time = onset step of the seed-mean learned fraction, online; DFG z0 = priority inside DFG's first round (descending round-0 z-score of the character's best test); DFG n / network n = the smallest n from which the final model carries the character (median of 3 seeds; network n only for |S| <= 4, the fixed-n study's recorded characters). Pairs (network time vs DFG n): ordered by the networks (onsets more than 1.35x apart) and concordant / tied / inverted in DFG's n order.

Network n onsets come from a 4096-point test-set mean of f chi_S, whose sampling sd on phi is about 0.0156/|yhat_S| (ORDER.md sec. 7). dnf3's two n-axis taus rest mostly on its characters with |yhat| <= 0.027 (sd 0.57-4.0), which that estimate cannot resolve; on its 21 characters with sd <= 0.1 (|yhat| = 0.19) they are +0.56 (net n, DFG n) and +0.87 (net time, net n).
